messages:
chee: Planning window for az12 tonight 00:30-02:30 UTC. Scope: staggered VM soft-reboots + NIC microcode. Goal: clear kernel regressions affecting large-batch jobs and reseed KV cache with minimal p95 impact.

chee: We'll do 6 cohorts (single rack each), 7m gaps. Primary constraint: limited cross-region egress from az12 to eu-central, so we'll avoid full backfill from eu if possible.

ravi: Can we use local spot warmpools instead of on-demand to save cost? Risk of preemption?

isabel: Proposal: pre-provision a small warmpool (2 nodes/rack equivalent) in az12 via burst-farm autoscaler, and use spot only as last-resort. We'll also enable transient instance protection for warmpool nodes for the 90m window.

chee: Runbook summary:
- 23:45 UTC: merge manifest PR (HPA floor + PDB relax + burst-farm config)
- 00:00 UTC: eu-central canary preheat (1 rack) to validate kv hit-rate and routing fallback
- 00:30 UTC: cohort A cordon + kvseed preheat; only finalize drain after kv hit-rate >= 68% or 12m elapsed
- 00:37 UTC onwards: cohorts B-F staggered with 7m gaps
- rollback if p95 > 220ms or error rate > 2.5% for 5m

isabel: kvseed command (controlplane):
```
./tools/kvseed --region=az12 --cohort=A --concurrency=5 --target-hit=0.68 --ttl=2400
kubectl cordon gpu-az12-02 && kubectl drain gpu-az12-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=75
```

ravi: Cost model: warmpool pre-provision (6 nodes) ~ $0.8k/hr. Spot fallback for 4 nodes/hr worst-case ~ $1.0k/hr. Finance pre-approved ops buffer: $3k for this month. Tag charges with "az12-warmbackfill".

billing-bot: [info] Ops buffer remaining: $2,600. Auto-tag rule for this window: billing_code=infra-maint-az12.

isabel: Routing note: announce suppression for TOR-level flips -> smart-routing will prefer us-west for new sessions while announces suppressed. Existing sessions remain sticky. If we see >4 BGP withdraw events within 10m, abort and roll back.

chee: Performance safeguards: set HPA cooldown to 6m and raise HPA min by 1 for affected deployments. Also relax PDB to allow one eviction per podset.

ravi: I'll own the burst-farm config and spot fallback play. Will also add a lambda to tag any emergency on-demand spend with the ticket ID.

isabel: I'll run canary and post kv hit-rate + p95 snapshots at each cohort boundary. If hit-rate can't reach 68% within 12m, we pause and investigate.

ops-bot: [scheduled] Maintenance ticket INF-2026-214 created. Window: 2026-04-02T00:30:00Z - 2026-04-02T02:30:00Z. Pager: infra/eng-sre.

chee: Final checklist before 23:30 UTC:
- PR merged (HPA/PDB/burst-farm)
- warmpool pre-provisioned and protected
- eu-central canary validated
- cost-tagging lambda deployed

ravi: Noted. I'll also set a hard emergency cap at $2k for on-demand; anything beyond requires manual approval from finance.

isabel: Ping @oncall if tail latency drifts. I'll keep a runbook window channel open and stream cohort metrics there. :headphones:
